title: Wiped data
body:
Update the other day wiped my data I’ve been tracking for nearly a year. New update to fix did not fix. No reply on Instagram when queried.

Like above review, would have been happy to give 5 stars before that. No chance now. No way you’re getting my money for the next year.
author: grandazz

title: Wiped
body: Yesterday you would have gotten 5 stars. This morning I check and all my data is gone. Wiped clean. I use it to track medicine as well as other habits. Important information for me and my medical team. Please can I restore the info???
author: MaryB13

title: No support
body: No response from email or instagram. Premium paid feature not working
author: Allenwixted

title: Insane pricing
body: €45 for a phone app - every year? Are you guys kidding me? It’s just a fancy alarm app, but €45 every year?
author: GrzzBrr

title: No Apple Watch App
body: Love the app but don’t think it’s too much to ask to have an Apple Watch application for it for the price you pay. Hope they’re working on that!
author: mattress_shmick

title: Please stop the popup
body: Will change to 5 stars if you can remove the “fake” time limited offer. Thanks.
author: LuDev

title: Too expensive - not worth it
body: I purchased this app last year, paying a “once-off” fee for all features. Now I can’t use the app/any features I previously had as it says I have to upgrade to premium again for an additional fee. Not worth it.
author: c.dono

title: Simple yet Sophisticated
body: Loving the look, simple yet sophisticated, comparing with other habit trackers which are both either under or over cluttered in terms of visuals. No-nonsense design where I can track my habits with ease!
author: kkozlovskyte

title: Habits made easier
body: Love it!! So easy and simple to use. Also so pretty with different colors!
author: Caoikhh

title: Simple , on the spot
body:
Thanks, its a great app really.
Add habits, have notification and color code. Thats all you need.
author: InassH.

title: Nice & Simple! THANK YOU❤️❤️❤️
body: just paid the full price love the app so much nice and straight forward!! But I can’t figure out how to delete a habit 🤣 doesn’t matter anyway LOVE IT
author: joannemkz

title: Great!
body: Could do with some more settings and customizable features
author: Terminator71

title: The only decent habit tracker
body: No dumb 3-goal limits like the other apps, no ads, no ridiculous monthly subscription. The app looks and works great; it was just unfortunate that I had to try 5+ more lousy ones before I found this one. Highly recommended.
author: 101Squirrels
